findings.rule: Dependency rule — shared contract (domain) imports an infrastructure type (type-only imports count)
findings.explanation: The domain-layer contract imports the Drizzle row type ReportRunRow from modules/reports/repository and embeds it in ReportDetailDto (latestRun), so vendor/shared depends outward on module infrastructure and transitively on db/schema. vendor/shared is mirrored into client/, so this couples the client-facing surface to a server DB row and breaks the mirror; it also means the raw row (workspaceId and other internal columns) ships over HTTP unmapped, since ReportDetailDto cannot be expressed as a Zod schema.
findings.fix: Define the latest-run wire shape as a Zod schema in the contract (reportDetailSchema extending reportSummarySchema, with ReportDetailDto = z.infer of it) and delete the repository import; map ReportRunRow to that shape in modules/reports/helpers.ts (toReportDetailDto) at the boundary.
